title: On the Impact of Extra Information in Bandit Learning: More is Not Always Merrier
abstract: arXiv:2611.33479v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: More data is commonly assumed to improve learning performance, however, we show that this intuition can surprisngly fail in sequential decision-making. Considering a stochastic bandits setup with exogenous extra information, we ask if the free and unbiased extra reward samples are guaranteed to reduce the regret of the learner. We introduce a formal notion of `non-degradation under extra information' and demonstrate that the widely used Upper Confidence Bound algorithm (UCB) violates this property, i.e., there exist benign extra-information under which UCB incurs strictly higher regret than when run without extra information. We contrast this behaviour with Thompson Sampling and Explore-Then-Commit, which appear to benefit from the same extra information. Constructively, we propose a meta-algorithm that provably enforces non-degradation for a broad class of bandit algorithms. We also run empirical simulations to study our meta-algorith

translated_title: 论额外信息对老虎机学习的影响：更多并非总是更好
translated_abstract: 通常认为更多的数据会提高学习性能，然而我们证明这一直觉在序列决策问题中可能出人意料地失效。在带有外生额外信息的随机老虎机设置下，我们探究免费且无偏的额外奖励样本是否必然能降低学习者的遗憾。我们引入了“额外信息下的非退化性”这一形式化概念，并证明广泛使用的置信上界算法（UCB）违反了这一性质，即存在某些良性的额外信息，反而使UCB产生严格高于无额外信息时的遗憾。我们将这种行为与汤普森采样和“先探索后承诺”算法进行对比，后者似乎能从相同的额外信息中受益。作为建设性贡献，我们提出了一种元算法，可证明地为一大类老虎机算法保证非退化性。我们还通过实证模拟来研究该元算法的表现。
tldr: 该研究揭示了一个反直觉现象：在随机老虎机学习中，额外信息可能使UCB算法的遗憾变差而非改善，并提出了一种能为广泛类别老虎机算法可证明地保证“非退化性”的元算法。
en_tdlr: This work reveals the counterintuitive finding that extra information can strictly worsen the regret of UCB in stochastic bandits, and proposes a meta-algorithm that provably enforces non-degradation for a broad class of bandit algorithms.
